description: Publishing plan for queued social posts: public right after preparation (every_hours 0) or one post per account every every_hours hours from start. ALWAYS parked for approval; runs only after a human admin approves it - in the app, or on the human's explicit request via resolve_pending_tool_call {human_request} with their own API key (never as an agent). publish:false removes the plan.

account_ids.description: default: all accounts with open posts

every_hours.description: hours between posts of one account; 0 = right away (default)

publish.description: false removes the plan; default true

start.description: ISO date-time of the first slot; default now

name: schedule_social_publishing
